items.title: Shell (LSE:SHEL) Could Be 5% Undervalued As Chemicals Sale Interest Builds
items.summary: Shell (LSE:SHEL) is back in focus after reports that ExxonMobil is among several bidders for its U.S. chemicals business, which could fetch about $8b and raise fresh questions about portfolio shape and capital priorities.
